mentions.name: Whistle
mentions.description: A free, fully offline transcription app available on all platforms with CUDA support. Current work includes tidying internal code, removing the larger model from mobile platforms, and implementing speaker diarization (who said what) so it can be used for more than just personal dictation. An iOS App Store release is planned now that the developer account is approved.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working away on a free, completely offline transcription app that's available on all platforms with CUDA support as well.
